rules.text: Match symbols on a line to win — **bigger symbols pay more**, and **Wild** substitutes for all.
rules.meter: Wins come rarely, and land big when they do.

tab.label: How to play

steps.item: Set your bet with the − and + buttons.
Press spin once, or **hold** for turbo.
Land 3 or more **Scatters** to start the bonus.

tab.text: Every spin costs your current bet and pays left to right from reel one. Wins are added to your balance as soon as the reels stop.

tab.label: Symbols

symbols.counts: 3 of a kind, 4 of a kind, 5 of a kind

tab.legal: Only the highest win per line pays. Line wins are multiplied by the line bet; scatter wins by the total bet.

glossary.entry: The return to player over millions of rounds — not a promise about any session.
How lumpy the wins are. High means rarer wins that pay more.
The most one round can pay, as a multiple of your bet. This game caps at 5,000x.

rules.heading: Free Spins
rules.media: Land 3 or more **Scatters** — or buy the feature outright for {{cost.free-spins}} your bet — to start {{freeSpins.count}} free spins with a rising multiplier. Free spins {{freeSpins.retrigger}} be retriggered.

timeline.step: Anywhere on the reels, on any spin.
The multiplier starts at 1x and climbs with every winning spin.
Every free-spin win is added at the multiplier it landed on, up to the 5,000x cap.

rules.heading: Super Spins
rules.text: The premium bonus: buy it for {{cost.super-spins}} your bet to start the free spins at a higher multiplier that climbs faster. The RTP stays 96.50% and the cap stays 5,000x.
rules.heading: Ante Bet
rules.text: An optional ante: every spin costs **+25%** more, and in return the chance of triggering the bonus naturally is doubled. Toggle it any time from the bonus button. RTP 96.50%, max win 5,000x.
rules.heading: Double Chance
rules.text: A stronger ante at **+50%** per spin for even better bonus odds. One boost can be active at a time. RTP 96.50%, max win 5,000x.
rules.heading: Controls

list.item: **SPIN** — plays one round at the current bet.
**Autoplay** — play a chosen number of rounds automatically; tap again to stop.
**Turbo** — shortens the spin animation; the result is identical.
**Menu (☰)** — opens settings, the paytable and these rules.

rules.heading: Features

cards.card: Boosts every win during the bonus.

section.title: Responsible play
section.text: Set a limit before you start. Autoplay stops on its own when your loss or win limit is reached, and you can stop it at any time.
section.quote: A slot is entertainment with a price, not a way to make money.

section.title: Disconnections and malfunctions
section.text: An interrupted round is settled the next time you open the game. Malfunction voids all pays and play.

rules.note: Malfunction voids all pays and play.
rules.small: Play responsibly. 18+. Terms and conditions apply.
